class.name: CubismMotionEvent
class.brief_description: A timestamped imported motion event value.
class.description: Data-only resource stored by [CubismMotionDescriptor]. Values, including Unicode strings, are not executed. Native motion playback owns event timing and deferred delivery; editing this shared resource is not a way to inject an event into an active motion. Setters emit [signal Resource.changed].

members.member: Source event time in motion seconds.
Event payload string delivered as data by native playback.
